question_contract.population: qual o hospital com maior receita total por especialidade medica considerando apenas hospitais com mais de 500 internacoes na especialidade

generated_sql:
WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade,
        i."CNES" AS hospital,
        COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
        SUM(i."VAL_TOT") AS receita_total
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN especialidade e
        ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC"
    WHERE i."CNES" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", i."CNES"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 500
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        especialidade,
        hospital,
        total_internacoes,
        receita_total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY especialidade
            ORDER BY receita_total DESC, hospital ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM agg
)
SELECT
    especialidade,
    hospital,
    total_internacoes,
    receita_total
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY especialidade ASC, hospital ASC
ground_truth_sql: SELECT especialidade, "CNES", receita_total FROM (SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade, i."CNES", ROUND(SUM(i."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS receita_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY SUM(i."VAL_TOT") DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes i JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", i."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY receita_total DESC
